def: intransitively, to become a pupil; transitively, to disciple, i.e. enrol as scholar

occurrences.text: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:
Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
